price_signal: €68/uur standaard les; 1,5-uurs les €102; TussenTijdse RIS Toets €299; CBR-examen €330 (€420 met faalangst/BNOR), per 1 juni 2026
notes: Solo rijschool run by instructor Berry van den Nieuwelaar; specialised in faalangst (test anxiety), AD(H)D and autism spectrum support ('faalangst specialist'). Car/B category only; theory courses offered. KvK CONFLICT: official CBR registry and rijschoolspecialist.nl list KvK 91304429, but the school's own website footer states KVK 91304296 (likely a website typo) - recorded the CBR-registered 91304429. Founding 2023 confirmed by rijloket.nl ('Actief sinds 2023 (3 jaar)') and corroborated by 2023 WordPress upload paths on the official site. No evidence found regarding English-language instruction or transmission type (manual vs automatic); CBR shows only category B. CBR exam stats (1 Apr 2025 - 31 Mar 2026): 31 first exams, 61% first-exam pass rate (65% overall rijschool), examen at Den Bosch (Hambakenwetering 13A). Note: educarplatform.nl/rijschoolnieuwelaar list differing per-hour prices (€61 losse les) - the official website is authoritative (€68).
